image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a tiger beetle (Cicindelinae) on a sandy, gravelly surface. The beetle has a dark, metallic body with distinct pale markings on the elytra and thorax. It features long, slender legs, prominent compound eyes, and very long filiform antennae.
